tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ yi dam gnyen po lha gsum gyi bsgom bzlas zab mo bzhugs so// 210)༄༅/ bla ma lhar bcas la btud nas/ yi dam lha gsum bsnyen 'od gang*/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom la/ stong nyid de bzhin nyid dang ni/ kun snang 'gro la snying rje bsgom/ rang rig rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥpa/ mthing nag cig la las e yam̐ bam̐/ sum̐ keṃ bh+rum̐ 'phros yongs gyur pas/ nam mkha' rlung chu pa gzhi dang*/ rib de steng gzhal yas khang*/ mtshan nyid kun ldan nang dbus su 'khor lo mthing ga rtsibs bzhi po/ phyogs mdog lte bar pad+ma sngo/ nyi zla klu gnyan gdan steng hrīḥ mthing nag da 211)babs gnas gyur pas/ bdag nyid rta mgrin mthing la rngam/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro chas rdzogs/ seng sdeng phur bu thugs kar 'dril/ zhal du sbrul gsol mjug ma la/ dor stobs zhabs kyis mnan cing brdzis/ phyag zhabs sbrul brgyan rna ltag gi g.yas g.yon sbrul rigs lnga 'phyong*/ rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad kyis/ khams sum zil gnon dbu gtsug tsher/ de steng sprul pa'i khyung dkar ni/ sgro gshog spu gri me 'bar lding*/ 212)bdag nyid thugs kar pad nyid dam/ phyag rdog mthing nag khro gtum g.yas/ rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon pa yis/ dril bu dkur bsten dor stabs bzhengs/ rang gi phyogs bzhi 'khor lo yi/ rtsibs bzhir rigs bzhi'i klu rgyal ni/ dkar ser dmar ljang zhi ba'i tshul/ thal sbyar sbrul mjug ldan pa'i zhal/ nang du gtso la blta bar bskyed/ bdag nyid thugs ka'i nyi stong hrīḥ bya khyung khrom dang phyag rdor hūm̐/ rnams dang gnas gsum 'bru gsum las/ 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs stim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha/ spyan drangs dbang bskur rigs lnga yis/ rgyas gdab thugs ka'i sa bon las/ 'od 'phros snod bcud gzhal yas lha/ sgra rnams drag po sngags kyi 'brug stong gsum gang bar rab dmigs shig gsal stong ngang nas drag sngags bzla/

na mo bud+dhā ya/ 213)badz+ra ki lo kī la ya/ nā ga du tsan+dhe tsa n+dhe/ mi li mi li/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā ga ni swā hā/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'bru po gnyis/ ci 'grub bzlas shing mthun mtshams su/ mchod gtor phul la snang srid kun/ thugs srog hrīḥl rab bsdus nas/ stong nyid bsgom zhing lhar ldang la/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas gdab bya/ las sbyor dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur ni/ skye rim gzhan ni sngar ltar las/ bdag gi sku yi ba spu'i khungs/ kun nas me yi tsha tsha dang*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs skar lngar 'khrugs/ snyan nas stong gsum gang ba yi/ 'brug sgras pa bdag klu snyan skrag shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma yis/ gdug pa can rnams gtor zhing brlag zhal nas sngags kyi dmod mthu dang*/ me spungs mtshon cha'i thog char 214)gyis/ byang chub sgrub la gnod pa'i gdon/ gdug pa mtha' dag gzhob tu bsreg rnam shes chos dbyings bstim par dmigs/ sgrub pa'i sngags 'di khri khrag bzla/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krid hūm̐/ badz+ra ma hā kro dha phaṭa bam̐ hūm̐/ e a ra li hring hring dzaḥ ma hā srog ta thun bh+yo phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro h+ya badṛ wa hu lu hu lu kro dha a we sha ya phaṭaḥ tshal pa tshal pa/ dum bu dum bu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ nī lām̐ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra rā dza nga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ha sa oṃ/ sa khri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de tshe cho 'phrul lhongs kyi tshul/ ci ltar byung kyang ya nga dang*/ 'khung 'khrig mi bya thams cad kun/ rang sems 'char sgor rlo thag bcad/ 'di ltar lnga gsum gcig dril gyi/ nyams len zab pa'i mthar thug 215)'dis/ bar chad kun bsel mchog mthun gyi/ dngos grub ma lus bde blag thob/ las 'brel rtsal gyi gtor gzhung las/ 'phri bsnan med par rgyun khyer du/ bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ dpal chen sku dang dbyer med shog ces pa 'di yang nam mkha'i rnal 'byor tshul khrims bzang pos bskul ba ltar/
bla brang chos dbyings rtser bkod pa / 216)
